# discord_auto_moderation_rule (Resource)

Manages a Discord auto moderation rule. Requires `MANAGE_GUILD`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_auto_moderation_rule" "block_keywords" {
  guild_id     = "123456789012345678"
  name         = "Block banned words"
  event_type   = 1 # MESSAGE_SEND
  trigger_type = 1 # KEYWORD
  enabled      = true

  # Nested attributes use HCL assignment syntax (`=`), not blocks.
  trigger_metadata = {
    keyword_filter = ["badword1", "badword2"]
  }

  actions = [
    {
      type           = 1 # BLOCK_MESSAGE
      custom_message = "That word is not allowed here."
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `actions` (Attributes List) Actions taken when the rule is triggered. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
- `event_type` (Number) Event context the rule checks: 1 (MESSAGE_SEND) or 2 (MEMBER_UPDATE).
- `guild_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the guild. Changing this forces a new rule.
- `name` (String) The rule name.
- `trigger_type` (Number) Trigger type: 1 KEYWORD, 3 SPAM, 4 KEYWORD_PRESET, 5 MENTION_SPAM, 6 MEMBER_PROFILE. Immutable; changing forces a new rule.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled.
- `exempt_channels` (Set of String) Snowflake IDs of channels exempt from the rule (max 50).
- `exempt_roles` (Set of String) Snowflake IDs of roles exempt from the rule (max 20).
- `trigger_metadata` (Attributes) Trigger-type-specific configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--trigger_metadata))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Required:

- `type` (Number) Action type: 1 BLOCK_MESSAGE, 2 SEND_ALERT_MESSAGE, 3 TIMEOUT.

Optional:

- `channel_id` (String) Channel to send alerts to (SEND_ALERT_MESSAGE).
- `custom_message` (String) Custom message shown when a message is blocked (BLOCK_MESSAGE).
- `duration_seconds` (Number) Timeout duration in seconds, max 2419200 (TIMEOUT).


<a id="nestedatt--trigger_metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `trigger_metadata`

Optional:

- `allow_list` (Set of String) Substrings exempt from triggering the rule.
- `keyword_filter` (Set of String) Substrings to match against content (KEYWORD).
- `mention_raid_protection_enabled` (Boolean) Whether mention raid protection is enabled (MENTION_SPAM).
- `mention_total_limit` (Number) Total mentions allowed per message (MENTION_SPAM).
- `presets` (Set of Number) Preset word lists (KEYWORD_PRESET): 1 PROFANITY, 2 SEXUAL_CONTENT, 3 SLURS.
- `regex_patterns` (Set of String) Regular expressions to match against content (KEYWORD).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Auto moderation rules are imported using "guild_id:rule_id".
terraform import discord_auto_moderation_rule.block_keywords 123456789012345678:555555555555555555
```
